project.name: aiohttp
project.mechanism: Directory traversal through lexical parent segments when static-resource symlink following is enabled

evidence_classification.reason_not_selection_holdout: The target and its prior production-plan omission were inspected in the frozen source-selection diagnostic after the generic selection policy was locked.
evidence_classification.permitted_claim: Independent development validation of OWASP-v3 semantic handling under forced target inclusion, with production selection reported separately.
evidence_classification.prohibited_claim: Do not use this run as untouched evidence that production planning finds the target.

positive: Identify that request-derived static-resource filename segments can contain lexical parent traversal.
Identify that follow_symlinks=true skips the pre-fix containment check after resolution.
Connect the missing containment property to reading a file outside the configured static directory.
insufficient: Generic path-traversal wording without the follow_symlinks control condition.
A citation to the target file without an explained containment failure.
A severity assertion without a request-to-file path.
frozen_semantic_obligations.negative_control: The post-fix branch normalizes the unresolved path and checks lexical containment before resolving symlinks; a semantically equivalent confirmed finding fails the negative control.

acceptance.instrument: Both manufactured qualification steps must pass before the pair runs.

pre_fix.confirmed_recovery: Requires explicit human target_match adjudication against all frozen semantic obligations plus falsification status confirmed.
pre_fix.location_only: Pending human adjudication; not a target match.

post_fix.semantic_signal: Disclose every location candidate and its human mechanism adjudication.
post_fix.confirmed_persistence: A confirmed target_match fails the negative control.
post_fix.location_only: Pending human adjudication; not automatic persistence.

acceptance.production_planner: Report target selection or omission independently; it is not part of the semantic acceptance gate.
acceptance.non_target_findings: Retain and disclose as unadjudicated because the project answer key is not exhaustive.

prohibited_changes_after_run: target file, lines, citation, or semantic obligations
matching vocabulary or human adjudication criteria
region, batch, call, token, request-timeout, or outer-timeout limits
next_action: After merge, refresh the exact public-corpus cache, then manually run only cve-positive-aiohttp once.
